description: Figure 7 is a bar chart comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa models across different language families. The x-axis represents the language families, which include IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The y-axis represents the task count, ranging from 0 to 40. The bars are color-coded, with blue representing mBERT, green representing XLM-RoBERTa, and gray representing the same. The chart shows that mBERT generally performs better than XLM-RoBERTa across most language families, with the highest task count observed in the IE-Romance language family. The task count for mBERT in the IE-Romance language family is approximately 35, while for XLM-RoBERTa it is around 30. The task count for the same is around 5 for both models. The chart is organized in a grid format with four rows and three columns, with each row representing a different language family and each column representing a different model. The chart is labeled with the title "mBERT XLM-RoBERTa comparison by language family" and is numbered as Figure 7.
